name: FriendFilter + GroupFilter
description: Established Chrome extensions for Facebook friend and group management — spot inactive / low-quality / fake connections so posts reach people who engage. Free / Growth ~$29 / Pro ~$49 per month. Rails + Vue + Postgres. Founded Mar 2019, US. ~120k estimated users; 337 active subs. Listed for asset sale (includes ~100k dormant email list).

mentions.evidence: ~$8,237 MRR, 337 active subscriptions, ~$6,904 L30, ~$1,796,102 all-time, ~90% L30 profit margin. Caveat: Stripe API key expired Sep 18, 2026; treat figures as last-synced cache.
mentions.indieAngle: Ship one durable browser extension that fixes a platform hygiene pain (LinkedIn connection rot, Instagram ghost followers, Gmail label chaos) and charge monthly. Maintenance + SEO > feature churn.

whyItPrints: Decade-old browser utility that still prints. ~$8.2k MRR, ~$1.8M all-time, ~90% margins. No AI-demo energy — Facebook graph hygiene that creators and marketers quietly renew.
